name: FileInput
label: File input
description: A click-or-drop upload zone paired with a controlled file list showing size, progress, and per-file errors.

props.name: placeholder
props.default: Drag and drop, or click to browse

props.name: files
props.description: Files to list under the dropzone

props.name: size
props.description: Component size (not the native character-width `size` attribute)

props.name: error
props.description: Error state — shows error styling and message

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper or error message displayed below the field

props.name: acceptHint
props.description: Hint shown under the placeholder when `accept` is set, given the `accept` value. Defaults to "Accepts" followed by the value.

props.name: onFilesSelected
props.description: Called with the newly selected files

props.name: onFileRemove
props.description: Called with the id of a file whose remove button was pressed

props.name: progressLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a listed file's progress bar, given the file name. Defaults to "Uploading" followed by the name.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of a listed file's remove button, given the file name. Defaults to "Remove" followed by the name.

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale file sizes are written in, such as `de-DE` (`1,5 MB`). Defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider's, else `en-US`.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes — applied to the wrapper, not the <input>
